title: From the 1988 plebiscite to the constitutional votes
goal: Tell how Chile moved from the 1988 plebiscite to the protests of 2019 and the constitutional votes, granting points with si bien.
grammar: formal concessive clauses with si bien and the indicative

items: I can grant a point and say what matters more with *si bien* + indicative.
I can say what happened in the votes of 1988, 2020, 2022 and 2023.
I can name the main words for the plebiscite, the protests and the vote in Spanish.
